metadata.guidance_markdown:
## Part 1: Security questions

Your answers must be the same as what you told us on your online claim. 
You will need the following information to hand:

* claim reference number
* national Insurance number

## Part 2: Amendment section

You will need the following information to hand:

* type of wages owed, for example salary, overtime or commission
* dates worked and not paid
* your payslip
* details of attachment of earnings

If you need to change what you submitted in your online claim, you'll need to answer all the questions in this section with the correct information.

You will need the following information to hand:

* type of wages owed, for example salary, overtime or commission
* dates worked and not paid
* your payslip
* details of attachment of earnings

what_happens_next.name: What Happens Next
what_happens_next.message:
We will update your claim with the new information you provided. We aim to do this within 10 working days. After we have updated your information, we will let you know if you are due a payment. You do not need to send us any further evidence to complete your application.

If you have not had a response from us within 15 working days, contact us at: [redundancypaymentsonline@insolvency.gov.uk](mailto:redundancypaymentsonline@insolvency.gov.uk)

Make sure you have told the insolvency practitioner handling your employer’s insolvency about the changes you have made to your claim information. They may need to change the information they provided the Insolvency Service.

To make another amendment to your redundancy claim, complete the relevant form from the [redundancy claim amendment forms](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/amend-a-redundancy-claim) page.
